about.title: Hi Iam Emanuel Ignacio Funes
about.aboutMe: I am a Full Stack Web developer, I master technologies such as React and Next.js for the Frontend, and Express, SQL and MongoDB for the Backend. I stand out for my speed in learning new technologies, efficiency in solving problems and ability to collaborate in teams. I am looking for new challenges to continue growing professionally and contribute to the success of dynamic and innovative technology projects. Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

experienceOne.title: Full Stack Developer
list: End-to-end development: Design and implementation of comprehensive web features, from conceptualization to deployment, using Next.js and TypeScript to create modern, responsive, and high-performance interfaces.
Backend Architecture: API development using Nest.js and Express, optimizing data persistence through the use of ORMs such as Prisma, Knex, and Mongoose.
Optimization and State Management: Implementing critical performance improvements to the front end using TanStack Query and efficiently managing global state with Zustand and Redux.
Work with clients to define technical requirements and ensure that projects are delivered on time.
Technologies Used: React, CSS, Tailwind, TypeScript, Vite, Next.js, Redux, ShadcnUI, ChakraUI, Express, Nest.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma, Knex, Socket.io, Git, CI/CD, Strapi.
